scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:edge && npm run build:safari
scripts.dev:firefox: rollup -c && node scripts/manifest-firefox.js && cd dist && web-ext run
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist && web-ext run
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist && zip -r ../evertest-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist && web-ext build --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:edge: npm run build:edge && cd dist && zip -r ../evertest-edge.zip .
scripts.package:all: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:edge
